name: Kairos Power
monetization: SMR developer (fluoride-salt-cooled high-temperature reactors); pre-revenue on power sales, monetizing via the Google master agreement to deliver 500MW of reactors by 2035 plus DOE/TVA demonstration support.

observations.metric_label: SMR fleet capacity contracted to Google by 2035
observations.notes: Master plant development agreement; first deployment targeted ~2030, fleet of up to ~7 reactors by 2035.
